events.trigger: User views the Home screen.
events.description: Logged when the main dashboard is visible.

events.trigger: User views the Stats screen.
events.description: Logged when the monthly insights and charts are visible.

events.trigger: User views the Manage Tags screen.
events.description: Logged when the tag management UI is visible.

events.trigger: User views the About screen.
events.description: Logged when the app information screen is visible.

events.trigger: User opens the screen to add a new transaction.
events.description: Logged when the transaction editor is in 'new' mode.

events.trigger: User opens the screen to edit an existing transaction.
events.description: Logged when the transaction editor is in 'edit' mode.

events.trigger: User taps the floating action button (+) on the Home screen.
events.description: Signals the user's intent to create a new transaction.

events.trigger: User taps the '<' arrow on the Home or Stats screen.
events.description: Tracks engagement with the primary date navigation.

events.trigger: User taps the '>' arrow on the Home or Stats screen.
events.description: Tracks engagement with the primary date navigation.

events.trigger: User taps the hamburger menu icon.
events.description: Signals an interaction with the secondary navigation menu.

events.trigger: User taps 'Theme' in the navigation drawer.
events.description: Tracks user interest in changing the app's appearance.

events.trigger: User taps 'About this app' in the navigation drawer.
events.description: Tracks how many users are viewing the app's metadata.

events.trigger: User selects a new theme from the theme dialog.
events.description: Captures which theme was selected ('theme_name' parameter).

events.trigger: User successfully saves a new transaction.
events.description: Primary conversion event for adding a new data point.

events.trigger: User successfully saves changes to an existing transaction.
events.description: Tracks how often users correct or update their entries.

events.trigger: User deletes a transaction from the bottom sheet.
events.description: Tracks a key destructive action.

events.trigger: User closes the Add/Edit screen without saving.
events.description: Indicates abandonment of the creation/editing flow.

events.trigger: User creates a new tag from within the Add/Edit screen.
events.description: Measures engagement with the in-line tag creation feature.

events.trigger: User creates a new tag from the dedicated 'Manage Tags' screen.
events.description: Differentiates tag creation context.

events.trigger: User confirms deletion of a tag from the confirmation sheet.
events.description: Tracks a key destructive action for data management.

events.trigger: User taps the back arrow on the 'About' screen.
events.description: Confirms the user has finished viewing the 'About' content.

events.trigger: User taps the Income/Expense toggle on the Add/Edit screen.
events.description: Tracks user switching between income and expense modes.

events.trigger: User taps the date selector on the Add/Edit screen.
events.description: Measures how often users change the transaction date.

events.trigger: User confirms a date in the date picker.
events.description: Tracks successful date changes.

events.trigger: User cancels the date picker dialog.
events.description: Tracks abandonment of the date selection flow.

events.trigger: User taps a tag chip to select a category.
events.description: Logs which tag was selected ('tag_name' parameter).

events.trigger: User taps the '+' chip to add a new tag.
events.description: Measures engagement with in-line tag creation.

events.trigger: User cancels the 'Add Tag' dialog.
events.description: Tracks abandonment of the in-line tag creation flow.

events.trigger: User taps 'Save' when the form is invalid (e.g., no tag).
events.description: Tracks user attempts to save with incomplete data.

events.trigger: SmartTagSuggester auto-selects a matching tag based on the note.
events.description: Logs auto-suggested tag name ('tag_name') and signal ('source').

events.trigger: User manually selects a different tag after an auto-suggestion.
events.description: Tracks manual overrides ('suggested_tag' vs 'selected_tag') to gauge suggestion accuracy.

events.trigger: User taps 'Scan Receipt' or 'Rescan'.
events.description: Opens the camera/gallery receipt source sheet.

events.trigger: User selects 'Take Photo' to scan a receipt.
events.description: Tracks camera capture usage for receipt scanning.

events.trigger: User selects 'Choose from Gallery' to scan a receipt.
events.description: Tracks gallery image selection usage for receipt scanning.

events.trigger: On-device OCR extracts structured fields from a receipt.
events.description: Tracks successful receipt field extraction.

events.trigger: On-device OCR finds no structured fields on the selected image.
events.description: Tracks unreadable or non-receipt images.

events.trigger: User confirms and saves an expense from the Receipt Review screen.
events.description: Primary conversion event for the AI receipt scanner.

events.trigger: User views the editable Receipt Review screen.
events.description: Logged when extracted receipt fields are displayed for verification.

events.trigger: User views the Finance Coach screen.
events.description: Logged when the conversational AI Finance Coach is visible.

events.trigger: User submits a custom question in Finance Coach.
events.description: Tracks natural-language Finance Coach queries.

events.trigger: User taps a starter or follow-up prompt chip in Finance Coach.
events.description: Tracks engagement with guided Finance Coach prompts.

events.trigger: User clears the Finance Coach conversation.
events.description: Tracks session resets in Finance Coach.

events.trigger: User taps 'Ask Coach' from the Stats Insights card.
events.description: Tracks contextual entry into Finance Coach from Monthly Stats.
